text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $81.5k while Ethereum shows mild strength at $2,419, suggesting traders are cautious but not panicked despite minor daily swings. The Fear & Greed index sits at 55 (Greed) but has declined 9 points over a week, indicating sentiment is cooling from earlier optimism. Bitcoin's dominance at 59.4% and robust 24h volume of $182B reflect a market where capital is present but not decisively rotating toward or away from altcoins—a neutral consolidation phase.
